# InstanceHA v1

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

instanceha/v1 is implemented by this SDK because pinned Gophercloud does not provide it. The resources below follow pinned openstacksdk and the official API contracts through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.InstanceHAV1(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.instance_ha`). Responses keep original fields, HTTP headers and status codes.

Masakari uses service type instance-ha, preserving catalog `/v1/{project}` and reverse-proxy prefixes. Route IDs are UUIDs; database IDs remain raw data. Segments enabled input requires numeric microversion >=1.2; `VMoves.InNotification(ctx, ref)` requires >=1.3. See [segments](segments/README.md), [hosts](hosts/README.md), [notifications](notifications/README.md), [VMoves](vmoves/README.md) for 15 resource operations and [waiting](waiting/README.md) for two proxy waits. Fetchable resources provide `WaitForStatus/WaitForDelete`: unlimited state waits with ERROR failure/2-second intervals and 120-second deletion waits. Host/VMove retain fixed parents; VMove GET rechecks >=1.3. APIs cover all 17 direct declarations; marker fallback, nullable inputs and full Resource/cache contracts need further comparison.

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.InstanceHAV1(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Segments.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Segments.Resources.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
